title: Error Spotting & Fill in the Blanks

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He don’t / know the / answer.’
questions.e: He સાથે doesn’t આવે: He doesn’t know the answer.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Each of the boys / have / a bicycle.’
questions.e: Each એકવચન છે, તેથી has: Each of the boys has a bicycle.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘She is / more taller / than her sister.’
questions.e: taller પોતે જ comparative છે; more taller ખોટું — She is taller than her sister.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘I have seen / him / yesterday.’
questions.e: yesterday સાથે Present Perfect ન આવે: I saw him yesterday.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The news / are / very good.’
questions.e: news એકવચન ગણાય: The news is very good.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He is senior / than / me.’
questions.e: senior, junior, superior, inferior સાથે than નહીં, to આવે: He is senior to me.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘One of my friend / is / a mechanic.’
questions.e: One of પછી બહુવચન નામ આવે: One of my friends is a mechanic.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘We discussed about / the problem / in detail.’
questions.e: discuss સાથે about ન આવે: We discussed the problem in detail.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The furniture / in this room / are new.’
questions.e: furniture અગણ્ય (Uncountable) નામ છે, એકવચન: The furniture in this room is new.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He has been working / here / since five years.’
questions.e: સમયગાળા માટે for: for five years. ચોક્કસ શરૂઆત માટે since: since 2020.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The mechanic repaired / the engine / quickly.’
questions.e: વાક્ય સંપૂર્ણ સાચું છે.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Neither Ravi nor his friends / was / present.’
questions.e: Neither...nor માં ક્રિયાપદ નજીકના કર્તા (friends — બહુવચન) મુજબ: were present.

questions.q: He is ____ engineer.
questions.e: engineer સ્વરથી શરૂ થાય છે: an engineer.

questions.q: I am fond ____ music.
questions.e: fond of = શોખ હોવો.

questions.q: The train left ____ time.
questions.e: on time = નિર્ધારિત સમયે.

questions.q: If I ____ rich, I would buy a car.
questions.e: કાલ્પનિક સ્થિતિ (Second conditional)માં બધા કર્તા સાથે were વપરાય.

questions.q: He prevented me ____ going there.
questions.e: prevent someone from doing something.

questions.q: She is good ____ drawing.
questions.e: good at = કોઈ કામમાં કુશળ.

questions.q: This is the boy ____ won the prize.
questions.e: વ્યક્તિ માટે કર્તા તરીકે who.

questions.q: The machine ____ by the operator every morning.
questions.e: કર્મણિ (Passive) Simple Present: is + V3.

questions.q: Hardly had he reached the station ____ the train left.
questions.e: Hardly / Scarcely ... when. (No sooner ... than.)

questions.q: No sooner did the bell ring ____ the students left.
questions.e: No sooner ... than.

questions.q: He insisted ____ paying the bill.
questions.e: insist on = આગ્રહ રાખવો.

questions.q: The workers ____ working since morning.
questions.e: workers (બહુવચન) + since → Present Perfect Continuous: have been working.
